purpose: Establish that the cumulative top-level fields on `message_delta.usage` ARE what Claude's own auto-compact trigger uses, by correlating the trailing assistant `message_delta` against the immediately-following `system.compact_boundary` `compactMetadata.preTokens` across multiple production turns (with and without advisor calls).

rawLog.reason: The captures come from ~/.claude/projects/<projectslug>/<sessionId>.jsonl which contain full conversation content (file paths, code, prompts). This sanitized summary records only the usage/preTokens table and the structural relationship; no message bodies are checked in. Originals live under ~/.claude/projects/-home-rmurphy-repos-agent-overflow/ on the capturing machine (verbatim turn lines listed below).

context.userAutoCompactBehavior: Compact fires when measured context >= threshold% of model context window.

topLevelUsage._note: Per-field values not retained in sanitized summary; only the input+cache total is meaningful here.

captures._note: Advisor turn. iter[-1] is half of preTokens. top-level matches within 0.5%.

Larger gap (~22k) explained by intervening hook outputs, nested_memory CLAUDE.md attachments (lines 1805-1809), and a fresh user prompt with an image attachment (lines 1810-1811) injected before the auto-compact check ran. The meter still tracks the parent's last accounted prompt size; the next-prompt content not yet reflected in the wire is the documented next-turn delta.

This is the smoking-gun capture. The user's screenshot showed the meter at ~15% before this compaction (= iter[-1]=146,167 / 1M). preTokens=294,675 was what triggered auto-compact at the user's 30% threshold (1M * 0.295). Top-level=289,917 would have shown ~29% — the correct reading.

aggregateRelationships.iterMinusOneCloseOnNoAdvisorTurns: iter[-1] equals top-level when there are no advisor iterations (single message iteration).
aggregateRelationships.iterMinusOneOffByHalfOnAdvisorTurns: iter[-1] is ~49.5-49.9% of preTokens when there is one advisor iteration in the turn.
aggregateRelationships._note: Outlier on no-advisor turn L1812 (-21k) is consistent with intervening next-prompt content (hook outputs, nested CLAUDE.md attachments, user-attached image) that hadn't reached the previous message_delta. Compaction sees the FULL pending context including next-prompt; the meter reflects only what the live wire stream has emitted, which is the right contract.

conclusion.contextWindowSource: message_delta.usage top-level (input_tokens + cache_creation_input_tokens + cache_read_input_tokens). The trailing message_delta envelope on a turn is the most accurate live signal.
doNotUse: message_delta.usage.iterations[-1] alone — undercounts by ~50% on advisor turns; the May 22 spike's 2× ratio is real cumulative processing, not double-counting
result.usage flat for the live meter (same correct cumulative as message_delta top-level, but the trailing message_delta already emitted it)
conclusion.advisorWireShape: server_tool_use(name='advisor') + advisor_tool_result are content blocks within a single parent SSE message; the parent's stream message does not terminate at the advisor call. message_delta.usage.iterations[] enumerates per-API-call breakdowns and is informational only.
conclusion.implementation: internal/provider/claude/parse_stream.go case 'message_delta' — direct json.Unmarshal of top-level usage fields into assistantUsage.
conclusion.supersedes: 1c1f9467 ('Use last parent iteration for context-meter, not cumulative sum') was based on the May 22 spike without a ground-truth anchor and read the 2× ratio as overcount. compactMetadata.preTokens correlation here proves the cumulative IS the correct signal.
